intelligent_control.caption: Six synthetic nonlinear model checks, with physical axes and declared operating conditions.
The evidence chain: assumptions, matched scenarios, constraints and interpretation.

intelligent_control.benchmark_learning.caption: Column A through nine learning stages. Control panels use a fitted scalar predictor; they are not full nonlinear column control.
ALSTOM: archived native trace, chronological output forecast and separately injected sensor modes. No simulator rerun.

intelligent_control.benchmarks.caption: Cart and pendulum: forces, upright convention and observable states.
Three tanks: coupled liquid flows and explicitly declared drain configuration.
CSTR: reaction, feed and coolant energy paths.
Column A: material flows, reflux, boilup and end-vessel levels.
Tennessee Eastman: external process architecture; native simulator evidence remains separate.

intelligent_control.experiments.caption: Unit 1: physical balance, excitation, training and held-out validation.
Unit 2: feedback, saturation and integral memory.
Unit 3: distinct information paths in feedback, feedforward and cascade.
Unit 4: prediction horizon, optimized moves and receding-horizon execution.
Unit 5: fuzzy memberships, inference and control action.
Unit 6: training-only normalization and separate neural evaluation.
Unit 7: evolutionary search and an independent evaluation stage.
Unit 8: uncertainty, matched information and evidence boundaries.
Unit 9: hidden modes and the distinction between causal and retrospective inference.

intelligent_control.methods.caption: MPC information flow and horizon conventions used by the course implementation.
Computed synthetic controller comparison; these curves do not establish industrial performance.

intelligent_control.markov.caption: Hidden modes, emissions and the observation boundary of a causal filter.

intelligent_control.markov_lab.caption: Computed sensor diagnosis on the independent synthetic evaluation record.
The same explicitly synthetic sensor-mode experiment mapped onto each benchmark output scale; not apparatus-specific fault calibration.

intelligent_control.physical_blending.caption: Conservative physical tank: nonlinear, linearized and variable-volume comparisons.

intelligent_control.pneumatic_physical.caption: Cylinder chambers, pressures, moving mass and valve paths.
Separate six-state mass/energy interpretation with explicit assumed valve parameters.

intelligent_control.hydrostatic_si.caption: Hydrostatic transmission: pump, motor, hydraulic storage and mechanical load.
SI interpretation with explicit displacement/capacitance conventions; source calibration remains unresolved.

intelligent_control.wind_control.caption: Rotor, shaft, generator and pitch paths in the reduced turbine model.
Computed local-LQR and scheduled-PDC comparison on the nonlinear reduced plant; later ROSCO map variant.
